Name: FS - Vanilla Pants and Skirts
Author: violetlizabet
Description:
If you're interested in doing outfit coordination in FS, but were wishing you could have the vanilla pants and skirts included, this mod is for you! It adds all of the vanilla pants and skirts as FS pants and skirts.

[u][size=5]How to Install?[/size][/u]
[list]
[*]Install SMAPI and Fashion Sense if needed
[*]Download mod
[*]Unzip
[*]Place into Mods folder
[*]Enjoy! Remember that to edit FS outfits, you will need the mirror. See [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969/]Fashion Sense mod page[/url]﻿ for details!
[/list]
[size=5][u]Which Pants and Skirts Are Included?[/u][/size]
All the vanilla items are included, which is the following items (spoilers ahead!):
[list]
[*]Dinosaur Pants
[*]Dyeable Baggy Pants
[*]Dyeable Farmer Pants
[*]Dyeable Genie Pants
[*]Dyeable Long Dress
[*]﻿Dyeable Pleated Skirt
[*]Dyeable Relaxed Fit Pants
[*]Dyeable Relaxed Fit Shorts
[*]Dyeable Shorts
[*]Dyeable Simple Dress
[*]Dyeable Skirt
[*]Dyeable Tight Pants (not obtainable in vanilla game afaik)
[*]Grass Skirt
[*]Luau Skirt
[*]Mayor's Shorts
[/list]
[size=5][u]That's Too Many Pants[/u][/size]
If there's any pants you don't want included, just delete their folder from the "Pants" subfolder of the mod. Poof, no more!

[size=5][u]I Want [i]Even More[/i] Pants in FS![/u][/size]
If you want to convert existing pants (which are already laid out in the 192x688 game format, so JA pants or recolored vanilla pants), you can use my Skirt Converter Python script to convert them: [url=https://github.com/elizabethcd/SkirtConverter]https://github.com/elizabethcd/SkirtConverter[/url]﻿ (see instructions in readme for details). 


[u][size=5]Credits[/size][/u]
None of the art in this mod is mine, all of it coming from the game (and therefore ConcernedApe) and all DP are going to Against Malaria. Thank you to PeacefulEnd for making Fashion Sense and for being very kindly receptive to my many small suggestions.
